## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm validate` passes
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes

For catalog entries (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/philmillman/altstrument/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)):

- [ ] Every link opens
- [ ] `license` matches the source repository's license file
- [ ] Versions are newest first, with no duplicates, and dates appear only where confirmed
- [ ] Summaries and descriptions are my own plain, factual wording
- [ ] No links to redistributed manufacturer firmware, and no affiliate links
- [ ] No binary files are added
- [ ] One device or one firmware per PR when possible

For site changes:

- [ ] Checked in light and dark mode, and at phone width
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes
